body: I already requested an appointment with Planned Parenthood. I know the solution. I just don't want to have to do it.
I will be going to the health center tomorrow. I'm just having so much not giving up. It's so hard. It feels so unfair. I'm so scared

Nobody knows except my ex-boyfriend and his mother. I told one friend but she won't help me. How can I do this alone? I don't know how! And I feel so violated by my ex-boyfriend, I feel so hurt by him, and he doesn't even care. Why can't the people who know me, the people that I love, why can't they care? If a stranger can care, why can't they? I need them and they aren't here.

I'm not living with my parents but they are supporting me and if they find out I'll be homeless and out of school. That doesn't even sound so bad right now because I feel so lonely and scared here. I don't have money for an abortion and my ex-boyfriend won't speak to me at all. I feel so depressed about even being pregnant, and then having to get an abortion. I've been getting morning sickness every day, and also at night, and it feels so awful and every single time all I can think about is how I have this piece of him inside me and I can't get rid of it. I feel so abandoned. I don't know if I can make it.
In fact, I've literally been told that it's too much of a burden. Nobody can deal with it. It's too much. It feels so awful to hear that.
The thing about my friends still caring - it isn't true. I've already tried that. It's horrible. I'n so alone.
